name: Legging It
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.

narrative.details:
We be seein' fewer and fewer travelers from Razor Hill. The scorpids were never much fun, but now I be hearin' there be spiders makin' their nest along the road.

If your travels be takin' you up north, kill some of the spiders on your way. Then, let Razor Hill know the path's a bit safer for them.
narrative.objectives: Kill 6 Ridgeshade Creepers and 6 Ridgeshade Lurkers in southern Durotar, then report to Gar'thok in Razor Hill.
narrative.offerRewardText: The peons have been scared to travel south for some time, Joruus. Now that you've cleared the path a bit, we can get them back to work.
